input: round-4 lane 5 brief: floorless and foundation options for ventures/shed-designer
task: shed-designer r4 lane 5: floorless shed, block/pier spacing, Lowe's concrete listing, search knobs

doc_friction.issue: The render hash covers the whole normalised design, so adding any design field redraws all 37 renders and conflicts renders/manifest.json with every other lane; take main's manifest and re-run make-renders after each merge.

deviations.why: Floorless is opt-in in the search, not a default knob: it is a different shed (damp, burrowers) and on the starter it costs $15.82 more, so making it a silent search move would not be clearly better and safe.
deviations.did: designsearch keeps the design's floor unless opts.knobs.floor asks
deviations.result: default search unchanged; opt-in search finds floorless designs on the front but never cheapest

goal: Floorless and foundation options for the owner's shed, priced and checked
notes: Local verification: node --test *.test.mjs in ventures/shed-designer after merging main: 404 tests, 0 failures (before the search-knob commit); designsearch, crossfeature, gallery, paretoaudit and levers tests after it: 39 pass, 0 fail. platform/pages/typecheck.mjs shed-designer: 0 diagnostics. make-renders.mjs re-run after the merge. Baseline run on main before any change had 2 flaky browser-test failures (3D orbit labels, store table catch-up) that passed on later runs.
